```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)

data("nyc_airbnb")
```

### Questions for this ds
* where are the most expensive air bnbs
* which neightborhood has the highest concentration
* which is the cheapest
* which hosts are the best reviewed
* has the number of airbnb increased over time
* which neighborhood has the best options for an entire home rather than private room?

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(mean_price))) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb = 
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(stars = review_scores_location /2)
```

```{r}
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan")
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type, 
    values_from = n
  )
```

```{r}
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 3)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(price < 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(neighbourhood_group)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  group_by(neighbourhood_group, room_type) |>
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
```

```{r}
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(calculated_host_listings_count >10)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

** ROTATE X AXIS TEXT:  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Brooklyn") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
